City of Round Rock on Instagram: "THIS is your bat signal, y’all. 🦇👀🚨 The City of Round Rock will participate in a statewide test of emergency alerting systems on Thursday, April 2.

This drill is unique in that it will involve emergency alert messaging from multiple levels of government in a short time frame. Testing will occur between 10 a.m. and 12:30 p.m. across the region for all city, county, state and other government agencies. Please know that these alerts are only a TEST to evaluate the functionality and effectiveness of warning tools, and no action is required. Do not call 911.

You don’t have to be a superhero to help keep you and your family safe! Turn on emergency alerts in the settings of your mobile devices and register for alerts via phone call, text message and email at: warncentraltexas.org

#roundrock #emergencyalert #texas"

Make Round Rock wholesome again!!!Testing these systems is swell, but using them when they’re actually needed is better. For instance, public warning should have been given about the $2,000,000 loss second alarm for that exposed more than 40 firefighters to carcinogens, sent smoke with carcinogens and other toxins into the adjoining neighborhood, and heavily contaminated water from suppression efforts into a storm drain and into Brushy Creek. Or for the very recent natural gas release at CR-112 and CR-117 that had thousands of city residents panicking and some even fleeing their neighborhoods due to a total lack of information coming from the City.Im so happy I moved to RR 🥹
